Watchdog Urges Met Police to Investigate Itself Over Suspect's Arrest

A police watchdog has recommended that the Metropolitan Police investigate itself concerning the arrest of a suspect identified as the 'Putney pusher'. The watchdog's statement indicates a call for internal review of the arrest procedures.
